prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1168; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection and wanted to make a left turn. I had a green arrow, or I thought I did. I started turning and a car coming from the other direction hit the front driver side of my vehicle.

Q: Had you come to a complete stop before turning?

A: No, I was already moving through the turn. I looked for oncoming traffic, but the other car came up faster than I expected.

Q: How fast do you think you were going when you started the turn?

A: Maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I was slowing down for the turn.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: The airbags did not go off, but the impact pushed me against the seatbelt and then back into the seat hard.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the accident?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff and sore, and the pain goes into my shoulders. I have headaches most days. I went to urgent care the same day and they told me it looked like whiplash.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I'm seeing a physical therapist twice a week and I take over-the-counter pain medication when I need it.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get my neck back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
